column1: # Phase 2 — Human-labeled tier-1 reversal setups (NQ first; ES later).
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Header below MUST stay as-is.
# Columns are tab-separated. Use a real editor with "show whitespace" on.
#   date          YYYY-MM-DD trading day in ET (cohort buckets below)
#   symbol        NQ  (ES rows will be added later if the pattern works)
#   entry_ts_et   HH:MM:SS.mmm in ET — the exact tick where the trade would
#                 have triggered. Millisecond precision matters: the analysis
#                 only looks at data strictly BEFORE this ts (no look-ahead).
#   level_label   one of: PDH PDL PDC POC VAH VAL
#   direction     long | short
#   outcome       pos = price reversed favorably to your TP / clean win
#                 neg = price approached the same level the same way but did
#                       NOT reverse (failed setup). Used as negatives so the
#                       feature search isn't poisoned by selection bias.
#   sl_pts        stop distance in points (your acceptable risk for this trade)
#   tp_pts        target distance in points (your minimum acceptable reward)
#   note          free text — what you saw, conviction notes, anything useful
#  Tier A (price-action analysis, ticks-only OK):
#  Tier B (deep L2/L3 MBO analysis, June days only — nested inside Tier A):
#  HOLDOUT (don't touch until final lock-in): 2026-06-12
#  Per day: 3-5 positives + 1-2 negatives feels right. Don't force quantity —
#  if a day was choppy and no clean tier-1 reversal occurred, leave it empty.
#  Negatives should be "this LOOKED like a setup I'd have considered, and it
#  didn't work" — not just any non-reversal touch.
